tier: Free week trial (USD 5 of phone time), then Starter USD 20 a month

free_tier.stated: New accounts get a free 7-day trial with USD 5 of phone time, then USD 20/month. Card required, cancel anytime.
free_tier.notes: The free week is one per person, requires a card and charges nothing for 7 days; Starter begins on day 7 unless cancelled. Parked phones cost nothing. The USD 5 trial credit is removed if the account cancels or the week ends unpaid.

per_object_cap.stated: An APK upload is at most 524,288,000 bytes (500 MiB), sent within 2 minutes; file uploads and downloads are at most 4 MB (4,000,000 bytes).

retention.stated: A parked phone keeps its apps, files and signed-in accounts; a saved phone unused for 30 days is deleted after a warning email a week before. Activity records are kept for 30 days.
retention.notes: The 30-day timer applies to a saved phone with no plan or after cancellation; recordings are kept 30 days on Starter and 90 days on Pro.

egress.terms: A phone is billed per second while it runs at USD 0.06 per phone-minute; parked phones cost nothing. No separate per-GB egress charge or allowance is published on the pages read. Traffic out of the Android device is part of phone time; unverified: per-GB egress terms

interface_detail: REST API at https://phonebox.dev/v1 with a bearer API key, a CLI and TypeScript SDK in the same npm package, a hosted MCP server at https://phonebox.dev/mcp, and an agent skill file. The agent reads the screen as a numbered element list, taps by label and installs APKs.
tooling: the phonebox CLI installed by a shell script, the phonebox npm package for TypeScript, the hosted MCP server, and a skill file for coding agents; no emulator or ADB is needed.
chaining: A coding agent installs its own APK on the phone, walks the screens it changed and parks the phone; a live view link can hand control to a person for a sign-in or a code.

limits.value: USD 5 of phone time over 7 days on the free week; USD 20 of phone time per month on Starter; 600 API requests per minute per key and 60 lifecycle requests per minute per project
600 requests a minute for each API key; 60 lifecycle requests a minute for each project
5 phones running at once on Starter and the free week, 20 on Pro, with 10 phones in a project; monthly spending limit USD 100 by default
524,288,000 bytes (500 MiB) per APK upload; 4 MB (4,000,000 bytes) for other uploads and downloads; 500 MiB of uploads held per project
a session is at most 15 minutes by default, up to 3 hours; idle timeout 60 to 3600 seconds, 300 by default; a saved phone unused for 30 days is deleted

limits_note: A session bills from create or start to park, with a 60-second minimum per session; the default 300-second idle timeout keeps billing after work finishes unless the agent parks the phone. Credit is reserved for the whole maximum session length at USD 0.001 a second, USD 0.90 for the default 15 minutes. A monthly spending limit of USD 100 stops new sessions. Phonebox has no phone number, SMS or calling.
binding_note: The free week gives only USD 5 of phone time at USD 0.06 a minute, about 83 phone-minutes, and the card is required to start it; that credit runs out before the 15-minute session cap or the 600-request rate does.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page says Sign up with Google or your email. Start with a free week. The pricing page says New accounts start with a free 7-day trial and USD 5 of phone time, card required. The plans page says the free week is new accounts only, one per person, and a card is required with nothing charged for 7 days.

reliability_note: A phone left alone after work bills until its idle timeout parks it, 5 minutes by default; a session reserves credit for its whole maximum length and a monthly spending limit of USD 100 stops new sessions. A saved phone unused for 30 days is deleted with a warning a week before. When no device is free, a create or start answers 503 capacity_unavailable.
confidence_note: The price, trial, card gate, plan credit, per-minute billing, retirement of saved phones and the per-project request and file limits are quoted from first-party pages read 2026-11-24. No per-GB egress price is published, so egress terms stay unverified; a sign-up would be needed to confirm the account flow.

notes: Phonebox rents cloud Android phones to agents over a REST API, CLI, SDK and hosted MCP server. A phone costs USD 0.06 a minute billed per second with a 60-second minimum; a parked phone costs nothing. The free week gives USD 5 of phone time to a new account but requires a card, so the identity gate and the USD 5 allowance bind first at about 83 phone-minutes. A session is at most 15 minutes by default and the default idle timeout parks after 5 minutes. No per-GB egress price is published. Phonebox is a device, not a phone number, with no SMS or calling.
